issues.problem: `init <topic> --budget N` runs `mb-work-budget.sh init` (which always writes spent=0, mb-work-budget.sh:119-133) before `st.locked(create=data)` (line 86) refuses an existing team. A refused re-init on a live team resets its spent budget, so the REQ-TEAM-025 budget stop is silently bypassed. Confirmed by reading both paths; the logic lens reproduced it (spent 400 -> 0).
issues.fix: Refuse early: `if st.team_file(bank, topic).exists(): raise TeamError(...)` before the goal/budget steps, or move the budget init after the create succeeded. Add a test: init --budget 1000, add 400, re-init refused, `status` still reports spent=400.

issues.problem: The default checkpoint dir `<bank>/backups/team` (mb_team_ops.py:115) lives inside the working tree and is not git-ignored (`git check-ignore` returns nothing in this repo). `mb_vcs.sh untracked` therefore lists the dir itself: each checkpoint tars its own `.cid.changed/.untracked` temp files and every earlier checkpoint's diff, tar, manifest and sha256 (size grows per checkpoint, earlier tars count against max_untracked_mb, a restore re-creates old backups). The same tars hold every untracked non-ignored file (stray secrets included), are written with the default umask, and show up as untracked candidates for a broad-glob `team commit` or a manual `git add`. Merges logic L2 and security SEC-3.
issues.fix: In `create`, after `mkdir -p "$out"`: `chmod 700 "$out"` (umask 077 for the writes) and drop a `.gitignore` containing `*` if absent; in the Python block also drop paths whose realpath is under realpath($out) from the untracked list (covers arc trees). Add a bats test with --dir inside the tree and two checkpoints: the second tar must not contain the first checkpoint's files.

issues.problem: `alive()` returns False whenever `ps -o lstart=` yields nothing (`now is not None` is required) even after `os.kill(pid, 0)` succeeded. Where `ps` does not support lstart (busybox/Alpine) or errors, every live holder is judged provably dead: the queue head reclaims the lock (line 176-179) and `tickets()` prunes live waiters, so two runs hold one mutex. On such hosts acquire also records pid_start=None, so the defect hits every lock. A missing `ps` raises FileNotFoundError out of proc_start instead.
issues.fix: After a successful os.kill: return True when proc_start is None (unknown counts as alive, never auto-reclaim or prune on it); compare start only when both are known. Catch FileNotFoundError/OSError in proc_start and return None. Add a unit test: monkeypatch proc_start -> None with a live pid gives holder_alive True and no reclaim.

issues.problem: Non-final `[ ] && [ ]` lists are ignored by bats errexit: line 100 (restore actually restored a.txt and new.txt), line 98 (clean-state precondition) and line 87 (same-id refusal exit code and message) assert nothing. The m4 restore regression only proves the hint evals. Same defect class as D2 in fix-verify.md, missed by the `|| false` sweep. Behaviour itself is correct: a strict copy with split assertions passes 10/10 (lead re-run).
issues.fix: Split each `&&` list into separate lines (`[ "$(cat "$T/a.txt")" = "$(printf 'a\nb')" ]` then `[ "$(cat "$T/new.txt")" = n ]`; `[ "$status" -eq 1 ]` then `[[ "$output" == *"already exists"* ]] || false`). Optionally extend the repo's `|| false` lint to flag non-final `] && [` lines in tests/bats/test_mb_team_*.bats and test_mb_lock_*.bats.

issues.problem: The contract part of the commit gate (`_contract_check`, lines 96-108, called at 164-165) has no team test: a failing contract item, an unfrozen contract, and ContractError/OSError all refuse the commit and route the track to fixing, but no test sets `--contract` on a track and runs `commit`. test_mb_contract.py covers only the contract runner.
issues.fix: In tests/pytest/test_mb_team_gate.py: (1) frozen contract with a failing item -> rc 1, `contract ... <id>` in stderr, track A to fixing, HEAD unchanged, index empty; (2) same contract unfrozen -> refusal mentioning 'not frozen'; (3) frozen and passing -> commit succeeds.

issues.problem: `route_fix` (gate-routed fix at the cap, `>=`) has no test at all: the only fix-cycle test (test_mb_team_state.py:106) covers a `fixing` track above the cap (`>`, line 112). This branch is the terminator of the verify<->fix loop; an off-by-one or deletion goes unnoticed.
issues.fix: Parametrized decide() test: gate actions ['fix A'] with A.fix_cycle=5, cap 5 -> ['stop_human fix-cycles:A']; fix_cycle=4 -> ['fix A']; fixing track with fix_cycle=5 -> ['wait']; fix_cycle=6 -> stop.

issues.problem: AGR-097 (a lease never auto-expires for a queue waiter) rests on the `not meta.get('lease_until')` guard at line 177, and `break` of an expired vs live lease (op_break, line 262) has no end-to-end test; only the holder_alive unit (test_mb_lock_queue.py:84) exists. Removing the guard keeps the suite green while a queued `run` steals an expired-lease lock from a holder still working.
issues.fix: bats in test_mb_lock_resource.bats: meta.json with lease_until in the past, live wrapper pid -> `run build --wait 1 -- echo ran` exits 75 and meta is unchanged; `break build --reason r` then exits 0 and posts the STATUS entry; a still-live lease makes `break` exit 1.

issues.problem: `--goal G-NNN` is stored as team.goal but never checked against the id in goal.md frontmatter; validation and acceptance always use <bank>/goal.md. A mismatched id is recorded silently. (Logic L3 read --goal as a custom goal file; commands/team.md:46 and design.md:324 define it as a goal id, so the 'different file' scenario does not apply; downgraded from medium.)
issues.fix: When --goal is given, read goal.md frontmatter `id` and refuse a mismatch.

issues.problem: `_merge` dedups external findings by bare id, so a finding whose id collides with a master issue id is silently dropped; an out-of-vocabulary master severity raises a bare KeyError (exit 2). The template prescribes `<name>-<cycle>-<n>` ids, which makes collisions unlikely.
issues.fix: Fail ingest on an id collision (or prefix `<name>:`), and validate master severities before counting.

issues.problem: `reopened` falls back to the previous_issues stub (no file/owner) for an item carried open from cycle n-2, so it routes to `stop_human review-unowned` instead of the owning track.
issues.fix: Resolve the original issue from earlier masters (walk back cycles) before routing.

issues.problem: Board reads fail open: `commit` ignores the mb-coord.sh exit code and treats empty stdout as {} (non-JSON raises a traceback), and `mb_team_status._json` (line 189, used at 208 for the board and 236 for locks) returns {} on unparsable output, so an open BLOCKED is invisible to both `commit` and `next` when the board read fails. Triggered only by a failing mb-coord.sh, hence minor. Merges L6 and Q-4.
issues.fix: Check returncode and JSON validity; on failure refuse the commit / return `stop_human board-unreadable` with returncode and stderr, in the form gate.py:76 already uses.

issues.problem: `close` does not check stop_success readiness, `close --pause` on a closed team sets closed=False (reopens it), and neither path (STATUS paused/closed, LIFT contract:<topic>) has a test. Merges L7 and T-4 (downgraded: 3-line code path, orchestrator-driven).
issues.fix: `--pause` leaves `closed` untouched on a closed team; `close` warns or refuses unless `next` is stop_success (or --force). bats: init, close --pause (closed=false, STATUS paused, no LIFT), close (closed=true, LIFT line, FREEZE gone from `mb-coord.sh active`).

issues.problem: `track set --status dispatched` bypasses the deps/overlap/max_parallel/unfilled-brief checks that only `next` enforces (REQ-TEAM-023/024/033).
issues.fix: On dispatched, run the same readiness checks and refuse with a hint (or warn).

issues.problem: `break` proceeds when holder_alive is None (meta unreadable). Meta writes are atomic (take via dir rename, setchild via os.replace), so this is a corrupt lock rather than a race, and manual break is the only escape hatch; still it contradicts the 'unknown' contract and REQ-TEAM-044 wording.
issues.fix: Require `holder_alive(meta) is False` for a plain break; allow an unknown holder only with an explicit `--force` and say so in the message.

issues.problem: `status` without a name lists only resources with a lock or queue on disk; declared but unused resources and their precondition values are missing (REQ-TEAM-048/053).
issues.fix: Also iterate team.resources from config.

issues.problem: Spec drift: REQ-TEAM-010/020 still describe mode direct and REQ-TEAM-016/021 work-only, while the code refuses mode=direct (AGR-103); mb_team_shared.py (shared-foundation stop) and mb_team_spec.py (spec_verify wave-end) ship without REQs.
issues.fix: Amend requirements.md/design.md: supersede REQ-TEAM-020, add REQs for shared foundation and spec_verify.

issues.problem: Residual of m4: some rendered copy-paste commands are still unquoted: the freeze hint (`{contract}` and `--tree {team['tree']}`, breaks on paths with spaces), `--range base..rev` in mb_team_review.py:61, and an unvalidated `--rev` in the external-review delta line (mb_team_review_external.py:49-50). Merges L12 and SEC-7.
issues.fix: shlex.quote contract, tree, base, rev in every printed command; validate --rev with `rev-parse --verify` (or ^[0-9A-Za-z._/~^-]+$).

issues.problem: commit_plan stages every changed or untracked non-ignored file matching a track glob with no protected-path filter; a broad glob can commit an untracked .env.local, CI or Docker file. Mitigated by the printed file list and confirm (but `--yes` skips it).
issues.fix: Move paths matching a protected denylist (.env*, .github/**, .gitlab-ci*, Dockerfile*, *.pem, *.key, terraform/k8s) to `foreign` with a warning unless --allow-protected PATH.

issues.problem: `--topic` is not validated in the script (cid becomes a path; `../x` writes outside --dir) and find_topic (mb_team_state.py:103) joins an unvalidated topic; reachability is limited because an existing team.json is required. The verify `<id>` is unvalidated too.
issues.fix: Validate topic and verify id with TOPIC_RE in the script and in find_topic.

issues.problem: No barging test: a `run` arriving while the lock is free but older tickets exist must not jump them.
issues.fix: Hold, queue W1, release, start W2 immediately; assert order 'W1 W2', repeated as the existing fairness test does.

issues.problem: The 3daadc6 regression (longest-first root stripping) skips unless tmp_path starts with /private, so Linux CI never runs it.
issues.fix: Build the alias with a symlink on any OS and remove the skip.

issues.problem: Deleted-file commit asserts only rc 0, not that the deletion is in the commit; refusal tests (lines 181, 188) do not assert HEAD and index unchanged.

issues.problem: Action order of decide() (fix, dispatch, extract, collect; mb_team_status.py:143-145) is not pinned, though commands/team.md tells the orchestrator to run actions in order.
issues.fix: One test with a gate-routed fix, a ready planned track and a returned DONE track; assert ['fix A', 'dispatch C', 'collect'].

issues.problem: Two atomic-write helpers: write_atomic uses a fixed `<name>.tmp` without fsync for review artifacts, mb_team_state._write uses mkstemp+fsync. Downgraded from medium: concurrent writers of the same master.json are a lost-update race either way; this is DRY/robustness.
